For 40 days, Democrats have shut down the very law enforcement agencies responsible for keeping our homeland secure and Americans safe.

Why? Because Democrats care more about criminal illegal aliens than American citizens. 

This the modern Democrat Party.

Video

Sheridan Gorman should still be with us, just as Laken Riley should too and many others. 

How many more times will this story be repeated? 
 
Democrats coddled criminal illegal aliens and created the system that allowed this to happen, and that’s why we’re so angry about it.

Video

America will win the AI race – but only if government resists the siren song of control and industry steps up as our patriotic partner.
 
In Congress, we want to ensure American AI is the gold standard of the future – and we intend to do so.

Video

The Democrat’s DHS shutdown strategy is clear:

Block paychecks for TSA officers and force Americans to wait in lines at airports across the country — while letting criminal illegal aliens skip the line to enter the country. It’s madness.

Republicans will keep fighting to end this senseless chaos and protect the American people.

Video

Democrats would rather make Americans wait in line at the airport than deport criminal illegal aliens. Let that sink in.

That’s why they REFUSE to support our law enforcement who keep us safe. 

Their political games put America LAST. It’s SHAMEFUL.

Congratulations to my friend  Markwayne Mullin on his bipartisan confirmation as Secretary of Homeland Security. 

I look forward to continuing our important work with you and President Trump to put America First — keeping our border secure, our communities safe, and our country strong.

While Democrats block paychecks for law enforcement and prioritize criminal illegal aliens — Republicans are fighting to support the 260,000 American heroes who serve at DHS and protect the American people.

DEMOCRATS’ goals are clear: protect criminal illegal aliens and allow them to flood into our American communities. 

Hardworking law enforcement officers and Americans are paying the price.  

For 38 days, TSA agents have worked without pay, straining resources and causing record airport wait times.


NBC News (@NBCNews)

TSA call-outs on Sunday, March 22, per DHS:

TSA call-out rate: 11.76%
Total TSA officer call-outs: 3,450+

Major airport call-out rates from Sunday:

• MSY 42.3%
• ATL 41.5%

It's simple: pass the SAVE America Act to preserve our Republic.
